title: One continuous aerial FPV shot, a single virtual lens throughout, no cuts.
content:
One continuous aerial FPV shot, a single virtual lens throughout, no cuts.

The camera flies one unbroken path at speed: low behind the advancing armored giant, forward past
him to the lone youth, once around the youth, then out along the stone's flight to the back of the
giant's helmet, and finally up and over him as he falls. All scale changes come from camera and
subject movement only. The camera never stops moving and never hovers; it holds a stable horizon,
banks naturally through turns, and decelerates only where it arrives at a subject.

MAIN SUBJECT: a lean youth in a coarse undyed wool tunic, bare forearms, dust on his shins. A
leather sling hangs from his right hand: one cord ends in a loop already seated over his middle
finger, the other ends in a knot. A smooth pale stone is in his left hand.

OPPOSING SUBJECT: an enormous armored figure seen from behind throughout — bronze scale
back-plate, a tall crested helmet, shoulders twice the width of a man's, a long spear in his right
hand. He is walking forward. A shield-bearer half his height walks ahead of him carrying a tall
shield.

FAR ARMY, behind the giant: deep locked ranks of bronze, tall rectangular shields overlapping edge
to edge, every helmet carrying the same crest, a dense upright forest of spears, dark banners
standing out stiff in the wind. The ranks hold formation and do not move.

NEAR LINE, behind the youth: a single thin line of men in leather and undyed cloth, mismatched
gear, wide gaps between them, few spears and no banners. Some shift their weight; none step
forward.

SCENE: a dry riverbed cutting through a wide valley at midday; cracked pale mud near the far bank,
loose grey gravel through the middle, water-smoothed cobbles at the near end; limestone slopes
rising on both sides.

[0:00-0:03] The camera tears in low and fast over the giant's shoulders from behind, banking hard,
and rises just enough to clear his crest without slowing. His shoulders roll with each stride, the
spear swings at his side, and the shield-bearer scrambles to stay ahead of him. Beyond him the
locked bronze ranks hold the far slope, shields overlapping and banners stiff in the wind.
END STATE: the crested helmet and scale back-plate fill the frame, the massed army behind them.

[0:03-0:06] The camera surges past the giant at full speed down the length of the riverbed, then
decelerates hard and settles at the youth's eye level. He is walking up the cobbles toward the
giant, stone in his left hand, sling hanging from his right, and he stops as the camera arrives.
Far behind him the thin line of men stands still and watches.
END STATE: the youth stands alone facing forward, the giant's armored back looming beyond his
shoulder.

[0:06-0:13] The camera slows to a walking pace and carries one steady circle around the youth,
holding him centred while the valley turns behind him. He brings the sling's pouch up into his
left hand, drops the stone into it, closes the pouch around it, and pinches the knotted cord
between his thumb and forefinger. The loaded pouch swings down and both cords pull straight. Over
his shoulder the armored back and the shield-bearer grow steadily larger.
END STATE: the loaded pouch hangs at the bottom of its swing with both cords taut.

[0:13-0:17] The camera completes the circle at his shoulder, then breaks away and accelerates past
him, gaining speed with every rotation of the sling. His shoulders set and he swings the sling
beside his head in three flat rotations, each faster and wider than the last, lifting grit off the
gravel at his feet. His front foot plants hard, his hips turn through, and his thumb and
forefinger open; the knotted cord flies loose, the cords whip straight, and his arm follows
through across his body as his tunic snaps against his ribs.
END STATE: the stone is clear of his hand and travelling.

[0:17-0:22] The camera locks alongside the stone at speed and drives with it toward the crested
helmet. The stone stays in the lower centre of frame, close and sharply detailed, turning slowly,
while the gravel and the valley floor tear past beneath it in heavy motion blur; the ground slows
almost to a standstill with grit hanging in the air, then tears past again faster than before. The
helmet fills the frame.
END STATE: the stone strikes the back of the helmet and the crest whips over.

[0:22-0:30] The camera climbs up and over the giant as he falls and holds looking down on him. The
spear drops and clatters onto the stones, his arms fall slack, he stands upright and motionless
for one beat, then one knee folds and his whole weight pitches forward until the scale back-plate
lands flat against the riverbed floor and dust bursts outward across the cobbles. The
shield-bearer drops the tall shield and runs. On the far slope the front shields drop away and the
forest of spears tilts backward as the locked ranks give ground; on the near side the thin line
breaks forward with arms going up and runs down onto the riverbed.
END STATE: the giant lies face down on the riverbed with the two crowds streaming in opposite
directions past him.

LIGHT: hard midday sun from high right; short dense shadows; heat haze rising off the stones.

SOUND: rushing air, close and constant; the low mass of an army below; the rising whir of the
swinging sling, faster on each rotation, ending in a hard snap; the air drops to near silence
through the slowed beat; a spear clattering on stone; the heavy collapse of armor onto gravel;
then a rising roar from one side and falling voices from the other.

STYLE: shot on 35mm anamorphic, 2-perf, grounded photographic realism.
Anamorphic character throughout: subtle horizontal lens flare on the sun,
oval bokeh in the out-of-focus gravel, slight edge stretching at the frame
extremes, gentle barrel distortion on fast camera moves. Visible film grain,
halation blooming softly around the brightest highlights. Muted earth palette
of bone, ochre and olive; hard midday contrast with detail retained in the
shadows.

AVOID: no cuts, no camera teleporting or jumping, no hovering or drifting, no sliding or floating
figures, no body fusion, no duplicate or morphing crests, no extra limbs, the sling cords keep
believable weight and inertia throughout, no on-screen text, no watermark, no music.

Una honda de cuero cuelga de su mano derecha: una cuerda termina en un lazo ya colocado sobre su dedo medio, la otra termina en un nudo. En su mano izquierda lleva una piedra lisa y pálida.

[0:00-0:03] La cámara irrumpe baja y rápida por detrás, sobre los hombros del gigante, inclinándose con fuerza, y asciende lo justo para superar su penacho sin desacelerar. [0:03-0:06] La cámara se lanza a toda velocidad junto al gigante a lo largo del lecho del río y luego desacelera bruscamente hasta situarse a la altura de los ojos del joven. Él camina sobre los cantos rodados hacia el gigante, con la piedra en la mano izquierda y la honda colgando de la derecha, y se detiene cuando la cámara llega. Muy detrás de él, la delgada línea de hombres permanece quieta y observa.  
ESTADO FINAL: el joven queda solo, de frente, con la espalda acorazada del gigante asomando sobre su hombro.

[0:06-0:13] La cámara reduce la velocidad hasta un paso de caminata y realiza un círculo estable alrededor del joven, manteniéndolo centrado mientras el valle gira detrás de él. Él lleva la bolsa de la honda a su mano izquierda, deja caer la piedra dentro, cierra la bolsa sobre ella y sujeta la cuerda anudada entre el pulgar y el índice. La bolsa cargada desciende y ambas cuerdas se tensan. Sobre su hombro, la espalda acorazada y el portador del escudo crecen de forma constante.  
ESTADO FINAL: la bolsa cargada cuelga en el punto más bajo de su oscilación con ambas cuerdas tensas.

[0:13-0:17] La cámara completa el círculo a la altura de su hombro, luego se aparta y acelera pasando junto a él, ganando velocidad con cada rotación de la honda. Él se afirma con los hombros y hace girar la honda junto a su cabeza en tres rotaciones planas, cada una más rápida y amplia que la anterior, levantando polvo de la grava a sus pies. Planta con fuerza el pie delantero, gira las caderas y abre el pulgar y el índice; la cuerda anudada sale disparada, las cuerdas se tensan de golpe y su brazo sigue el movimiento cruzando el cuerpo mientras la túnica chasquea contra sus costillas.  
ESTADO FINAL: la piedra ya ha salido de su mano y va en vuelo.

[0:17-0:22] La cámara se fija junto a la piedra a gran velocidad y avanza con ella hacia el casco con penacho. La piedra permanece en el centro inferior del encuadre, cercana y nítidamente detallada, girando lentamente, mientras la grava y el suelo del valle pasan a toda velocidad por debajo en un fuerte desenfoque de movimiento; el terreno casi se detiene, con el polvo suspendido en el aire, y luego vuelve a pasar aún más rápido que antes. El casco llena el encuadre.  
ESTADO FINAL: la piedra golpea la parte trasera del casco y el penacho se sacude hacia delante.

[0:22-0:30] La cámara asciende y sobrevuela al gigante mientras cae y se mantiene mirando hacia abajo. La lanza cae y repiquetea sobre las piedras, sus brazos se aflojan, permanece erguido e inmóvil un instante, luego una rodilla cede y todo su peso se proyecta hacia delante hasta que la espalda con placas de escamas queda plana contra el lecho del río y el polvo estalla hacia afuera sobre los cantos rodados. El portador del escudo suelta el escudo alto y corre. En la ladera lejana, los escudos de la primera fila se apartan y el bosque de lanzas se inclina hacia atrás mientras las filas cerradas ceden terreno; del lado cercano, la delgada línea rompe hacia delante con los brazos en alto y corre cuesta abajo hacia el lecho del río.  
ESTADO FINAL: el gigante yace boca abajo en el lecho del río mientras las dos multitudes se desplazan en direcciones opuestas a su alrededor.

SONIDO: aire en movimiento, cercano y constante; la masa grave de un ejército abajo; el zumbido creciente de la honda al girar, más rápido en cada rotación, terminando en un chasquido seco; el aire cae casi al silencio durante el compás ralentizado; una lanza repiqueteando sobre la piedra; el pesado derrumbe de la armadura sobre la grava; luego un rugido creciente de un lado y voces que se apagan del otro.

s’incline naturellement dans les virages, et ne ralentit que lorsqu’elle atteint un sujet.

fronde en cuir pend de sa main droite : une corde se termine par une boucle déjà passée autour de son majeur, l’autre se termine par un nœud. Une
pierre lisse et pâle est dans sa main gauche.

SUJET OPPOSÉ : une immense silhouette cuirassée vue de dos en permanence — plaque dorsale en écailles de bronze, haut casque à cimier, épaules deux fois plus larges que celles d’un homme, longue lance dans sa main droite. forêt de lances s’incline vers l’arrière tandis que les rangs serrés cèdent du terrain ; du côté proche, la mince ligne

ÉTAT FINAL : le géant gît face contre terre sur le lit de la rivière, tandis que les deux foules s’écoulent en sens opposés de part et d’autre de lui.

SON : air qui siffle, proche et constant ; la masse sourde d’une armée en contrebas ; le bourdonnement croissant de la

halation se diffusant doucement autour des hautes lumières les plus brillantes. Palette terre atténuée

À ÉVITER : aucune coupe, aucune téléportation ou saut de caméra, aucun flottement ni dérive, aucune figure glissante ou flottante,

[0:00-0:03] カメラは巨人の肩越しの背後から低く速く突入し、急角度でバンクしながら、速度を落とさずに兜の飾り羽をかろうじて越える高さまで上昇する。彼の肩は歩みごとに揺れ、槍は脇で揺れ、盾持ちは彼の前を保とうと慌てている。彼の向こうでは、青銅の密集隊形が遠い斜面を押さえ、盾は重なり合い、旗は風の中で硬く立っている。
END STATE: 飾り羽付き兜と鱗状背甲が画面いっぱいに広がり、その背後に大軍が見える。

[0:03-0:06] カメラは川床に沿って巨人の脇を全速で突き抜け、その後、強く減速して若者の目線の高さに落ち着く。若者は丸石の上を巨人へ向かって歩いており、左手に石、右手に投石紐を垂らしている。カメラが到着すると彼は立ち止まる。はるか後方では、細い列の男たちが静止して見守っている。
END STATE: 若者は一人で正面を向いて立ち、巨人の鎧の背がその肩越しに迫っている。

[0:06-0:13] カメラは歩く速さまで落ち、若者の周囲を安定した一周で回る。谷が彼の背後で回転していく間、彼を画面中央に保つ。彼は投石紐の袋を左手に持ち上げ、石をそこへ落とし、袋を閉じて包み込み、結び目のある紐を親指と人差し指でつまむ。重みの乗った袋が下へ振れ、両方の紐がまっすぐ張る。肩越しには、鎧の背と盾持ちが着実に大きくなっていく。
END STATE: 重みの乗った袋が振りの最下点に垂れ下がり、両方の紐が張っている。

[0:13-0:17] カメラは彼の肩の位置で一周を終えると、そこから離脱して彼の前を加速し、投石紐の回転ごとに速度を増していく。彼は肩を固め、頭の横で投石紐を三回、平らに振る。回転ごとに速く、広くなり、足元の砂利から砂ぼこりを巻き上げる。前足が強く踏み込まれ、腰が回転し、親指と人差し指が開く。結び目のある紐が解き放たれ、紐はまっすぐにしなり、腕は体の前を通って振り抜かれ、チュニックが肋骨に打ちつけられる。
END STATE: 石は彼の手を離れ、飛翔している。

[0:17-0:22] カメラは高速で石の横に固定され、そのまま石とともに飾り羽付き兜へ向かって突き進む。石は画面下中央に留まり、近くで鮮明に描写され、ゆっくり回転する。一方、その下では砂利と谷底が強いモーションブラーで流れ去る。地面は砂ぼこりが空中に漂う中でほとんど停止したかのように遅くなり、その後、以前より速く再び流れ去る。兜が画面いっぱいに広がる。
END STATE: 石が兜の後頭部に当たり、飾り羽が大きくしなる。

[0:22-0:30] カメラは巨人が倒れるのに合わせて上へ、そして越えていき、彼を見下ろす位置で留まる。槍が落ちて石の上で鳴り、腕は力なく垂れ下がる。彼は一拍だけ直立したまま動かず、それから片膝が折れ、全体重が前へ崩れ、鱗状背甲が川床の地面に平らに落ち、砂ぼこりが丸石の上へ外向きに噴き出す。盾持ちは高い盾を落として走る。遠い斜面では前列の盾が崩れ落ち、密集した槍の林が後ろへ傾き、密集隊形が押し返される。手前側では細い列が腕を上げながら前へ崩れ出し、川床へ駆け下りる。
END STATE: 巨人は川床にうつ伏せで倒れ、その両側を二つの群衆が反対方向へ流れ去っていく。

LIGHT: 高い右手から差す、真昼の強い太陽光。短く濃い影。石の上から立ちのぼる陽炎。

SOUND: 近くで絶え間なく吹き抜ける風。下方にある軍勢の低い重み。回転する投石紐の高まる唸りが、回転ごとに速くなり、最後は鋭い音で切れる。遅くなった拍の間、空気はほとんど無音に

ko.content:
당신은 AI 및 크리에이티브 테크놀로지 콘텐츠를 전문으로 하는 전문 번역가입니다.

다음 텍스트를 한국어로 번역하세요.

규칙:
1. 모든 기술 용어는 정확하게 유지할 것(예: "prompt", "cinematic", "camera pan"은 영어로 두거나 대상 언어에서 통용되는 번역을 사용할 수 있음).
2. 직역이 아니라, 대상 언어에서 자연스럽고 유창한 톤을 유지할 것.
3. 형식(줄바꿈, 글머리표 등)은 그대로 보존할 것.
4. 텍스트에 실제 Seedance/AI prompt(생성 지시문)가 포함되어 있다면, 해당 부분은 영어로 유지하고 주변의 맥락/설명만 번역할 것.

번역할 텍스트:
---
끊김 없는 하나의 공중 FPV 샷, 처음부터 끝까지 단일 가상 렌즈, 컷 없음.

카메라는 한 번도 끊기지 않는 경로를 빠른 속도로 비행한다: 전진하는 장갑 거인의 뒤쪽 낮은 위치에서 시작해, 그를 지나 외로운 청년에게 다가가고, 청년 주위를 한 바퀴 돌고, 이어 돌이 날아가는 궤적을 따라 거인의 투구 뒤쪽으로 나아간 뒤, 마지막으로 그가 쓰러질 때 그 위로 올라가 넘어간다. 모든 스케일 변화는 오직 카메라와 피사체의 움직임에서만 비롯된다. 카메라는 절대 멈추거나 공중에 정지하지 않으며, 안정된 수평선을 유지하고, 회전할 때는 자연스럽게 뱅크하며, 피사체에 도달하는 지점에서만 감속한다.

주요 피사체: 거칠고 염색하지 않은 울 튜닉을 입은 마른 청년, 드러난 팔뚝, 정강이에는 먼지가 묻어 있다. 가죽 새총이 그의 오른손에 걸려 있는데, 한쪽 끈 끝은 이미 가운데 손가락에 걸린 고리로 되어 있고, 다른 한쪽 끝은 매듭으로 끝난다. 매끈하고 옅은 돌멩이 하나가 그의 왼손에 있다.

대립 피사체: 내내 뒤에서만 보이는 거대한 장갑 인물 — 청동 비늘 갑옷의 등판, 높은 볏이 달린 투구, 사람의 두 배는 되어 보이는 어깨, 오른손의 긴 창. 그는 앞으로 걸어가고 있다. 그의 절반 높이쯤 되는 방패병이 앞에서 높은 방패를 들고 걷는다.

먼 군대, 거인 뒤쪽: 청동으로 된 깊고 촘촘한 대열, 가장자리가 서로 겹쳐지는 높은 직사각형 방패들, 모든 투구에 같은 볏, 빽빽하게 곧게 선 창의 숲, 바람 속에서 뻣뻣하게 서 있는 어두운 깃발들. 대열은 진형을 유지하며 움직이지 않는다.

가까운 전열, 청년 뒤쪽: 가죽과 염색하지 않은 천을 입은 남자들의 가느다란 한 줄, 제각각인 장비, 넓게 벌어진 간격, 적은 수의 창과 깃발 없음. 몇몇은 체중을 옮길 뿐, 앞으로 나서는 이는 없다.

장면: 한낮의 넓은 계곡을 가로지르는 마른 강바닥; 먼 둑 근처의 갈라진 옅은 진흙, 가운데는 느슨한 회색 자갈, 가까운 쪽 끝은 물에 닳아 매끈해진 둥근 자갈들; 양쪽으로 솟아오른 석회암 경사면.

[0:00-0:03] 카메라는 뒤에서 거인의 어깨 위를 낮고 빠르게 파고들며, 급하게 뱅크한 뒤 속도를 늦추지 않고 그의 볏을 간신히 넘길 만큼만 올라간다. 그의 어깨는 걸음마다 굴러가고, 창은 옆에서 흔들리며, 방패병은 그보다 앞서기 위해 허둥댄다. 그 너머로 잠긴 청동 대열이 먼 경사면을 지키고 있고, 방패들은 서로 겹쳐 있으며 깃발들은 바람 속에서 뻣뻣하다.
END STATE: 볏 달린 투구와 비늘 등판이 프레임을 가득 채우고, 그 뒤로 대규모 군대가 보인다.

[0:03-0:06] 카메라는 강바닥의 길을 따라 거인을 전속력으로 지나쳐 돌진한 뒤, 급격히 감속해 청년의 눈높이에 맞춰 멈춘다. 그는 왼손에 돌을 쥔 채, 오른손에 새총을 늘어뜨리고 거인을 향해 둥근 자갈 위를 걸어오다가, 카메라가 도착하자 멈춘다. 그 뒤 먼 곳에서 가느다란 남자들의 줄은 가만히 서서 지켜본다.
END STATE: 청년은 홀로 정면을 바라보고 서 있고, 그의 어깨 너머로 거인의 장갑 입은 등이 우뚝 솟아 있다.

[0:06-0:13] 카메라는 걷는 속도로 느려지고, 청년을 화면 중앙에 두며 그 주위를 한 번 안정적으로 돈다. 계곡이 그의 뒤에서 돌아가는 동안 그는 새총의 주머니를 왼손으로 들어 올려 돌을 넣고, 주머니를 감싸 쥔 뒤 매듭진 끈을 엄지와 검지로 집는다. 돌이 들어간 주머니가 아래로 늘어지며 두 끈이 곧게 팽팽해진다. 그의 어깨 너머로 장갑 입은 등과 방패병이 점점 더 크게 다가온다.
END STATE: 돌이 들어간 주머니가 흔들림의 맨 아래에서 매달려 있고, 두 끈은 팽팽하다.

[0:13-0:17] 카메라는 그의 어깨 높이에서 원을 마무리한 뒤, 그를 벗어나 가속하며 지나쳐 간다. 새총이 회전할 때마다 속도가 붙는다. 그의 어깨는 단단히 고정되고, 그는 머리 옆에서 새총을 세 번 평평하게 휘두르는데, 매번 더 빠르고 더 크게 돌아가며 발밑 자갈에서 먼지를 일으킨다. 앞발이 강하게 디뎌지고, 엉덩이가 회전하며, 엄지와 검지가 열린다; 매듭진 끈이 풀려 날아가고, 끈들은 곧게 채찍처럼 펴지며, 그의 팔은 몸을 가로질러 후속 동작을 이어가고 튜닉은 갈비뼈에 맞닿아 휘날린다.
END STATE: 돌은 그의 손을 완전히 떠나 날아가고 있다.

[0:17-0:22] 카메라는 빠른 속도로 돌과 나란히 붙어 함께 움직이며 볏 달린 투구를 향해 돌진한다. 돌은 프레임 하단 중앙에 머물며, 가깝고 선명하게 디테일이 살아 있는 채 천천히 회전하고, 그 아래로 자갈과 계곡 바닥이 강한 모션 블러 속에서 쏜살같이 스쳐 지나간다; 땅은 공중에 먼지가 떠 있는 듯 거의 정지한 것처럼 느려졌다가, 이전보다 더 빠르게 다시 질주한다. 투구가 프레임을 가득 채운다.
END STATE: 돌이 투구 뒤쪽을 강타하고, 볏이 휘어 넘어간다.

[0:22-0:30] 카메라는 거인이 쓰러지는 동안 그 위로 올라가 넘어가며, 아래를 내려다보는 시점을 유지한다. 창이 떨어져 돌 위에 부딪히며 요란하게 울리고, 그의 팔은 힘없이 축 늘어진다. 그는 한 박자 동안 곧게 서서 움직이지 않다가, 한쪽 무릎이 꺾이고 온몸의 무게가 앞으로 쏠리며 비늘 등판이 강바닥에 평평하게 닿을 때까지 쓰러지고, 먼지가 둥근 자갈 위로 사방으로 터져 나온다. 방패병은 높은 방패를 떨어뜨리고 달아난다. 먼 경사면에서는 앞줄의 방패들이 아래로 떨어져 나가고, 잠겨 있던 대열이 물러서며 창의 숲이 뒤로 기울어진다. 가까운 쪽에서는 가느다란 전열이 팔을 치켜들며 앞으로 무너져 나오고 강바닥으로 달려 내려간

pt.content:
Você é um tradutor profissional especializado em conteúdo de IA e tecnologia criativa.

Traduza o texto a seguir para o português (Brasil).

Regras:
1. Mantenha todos os termos técnicos com precisão (por exemplo, "prompt", "cinematic", "camera pan" podem permanecer em inglês ou usar traduções consagradas no idioma de destino).
2. Mantenha o tom natural e fluente no idioma de destino — não faça uma tradução palavra por palavra.
3. Preserve qualquer formatação (quebras de linha, marcadores).
4. Se o texto contiver um prompt real de Seedance/IA (instruções de geração), mantenha-o em inglês e traduza apenas o contexto/explicação ao redor.

Texto para traduzir:
---
One continuous aerial FPV shot, a single virtual lens throughout, no cuts.

The camera flies one unbroken path at speed: low behind the advancing armored giant, forward past
him to the lone youth, once around the youth, then out along the stone's flight to the back of the
giant's helmet, and finally up and over him as he falls. All scale changes come from camera and
subject movement only. The camera never stops moving and never hovers; it holds a stable horizon,
banks naturally through turns, and decelerates only where it arrives at a subject.

MAIN SUBJECT: a lean youth in a coarse undyed wool tunic, bare forearms, dust on his shins. A
leather sling hangs from his right hand: one cord ends in a loop already seated over his middle
finger, the other ends in a knot. A smooth pale stone is in his left hand.

OPPOSING SUBJECT: an enormous armored figure seen from behind throughout — bronze scale
back-plate, a tall crested helmet, shoulders twice the width of a man's, a long spear in his right
hand. He is walking forward. A shield-bearer half his height walks ahead of him carrying a tall
shield.

FAR ARMY, behind the giant: deep locked ranks of bronze, tall rectangular shields overlapping edge
to edge, every helmet carrying the same crest, a dense upright forest of spears, dark banners
standing out stiff in the wind. The ranks hold formation and do not move.

NEAR LINE, behind the youth: a single thin line of men in leather and undyed cloth, mismatched
gear, wide gaps between them, few spears and no banners. Some shift their weight; none step
forward.

SCENE: a dry riverbed cutting through a wide valley at midday; cracked pale mud near the far bank,
loose grey gravel through the middle, water-smoothed cobbles at the near end; limestone slopes
rising on both sides.

[0:00-0:03] The camera tears in low and fast over the giant's shoulders from behind, banking hard,
and rises just enough to clear his crest without slowing. His shoulders roll with each stride, the
spear swings at his side, and the shield-bearer scrambles to stay ahead of him. Beyond him the
locked bronze ranks hold the far slope, shields overlapping and banners stiff in the wind.
END STATE: the crested helmet and scale back-plate fill the frame, the massed army behind them.

[0:03-0:06] The camera surges past the giant at full speed down the length of the riverbed, then
decelerates hard and settles at the youth's eye level. He is walking up the cobbles toward the
giant, stone in his left hand, sling hanging from his right, and he stops as the camera arrives.
Far behind him the thin line of men stands still and watches.
END STATE: the youth stands alone facing forward, the giant's armored back looming beyond his
shoulder.

[0:06-0:13] The camera slows to a walking pace and carries one steady circle around the youth,
holding him centred while the valley turns behind him. He brings the sling's pouch up into his
left hand, drops the stone into it, closes the pouch around it, and pinches the knotted cord
between his thumb and forefinger. The loaded pouch swings down and both cords pull straight. Over
his shoulder the armored back and the shield-bearer grow steadily larger.
END STATE: the loaded pouch hangs at the bottom of its swing with both cords taut.

[0:13-0:17] The camera completes the circle at his shoulder, then breaks away and accelerates past
him, gaining speed with every rotation of the sling. His shoulders set and he swings the sling
beside his head in three flat rotations, each faster and wider than the last, lifting grit off the
gravel at his feet. His front foot plants hard, his hips turn through, and his thumb and
forefinger open; the knotted cord flies loose, the cords whip straight, and his arm follows
through across his body as his tunic snaps against his ribs.
END STATE: the stone is clear of his hand and travelling.

[0:17-0:22] The camera locks alongside the stone at speed and drives with it toward the crested
helmet. The stone stays in the lower centre of frame, close and sharply detailed, turning slowly,
while the gravel and the valley floor tear past beneath it in heavy motion blur; the ground slows
almost to a standstill with grit hanging in the air, then tears past again faster than before. The
helmet fills the frame.
END STATE: the stone strikes the back of the helmet and the crest whips over.

[0:22-0:30] The camera climbs up and over the giant as he falls and holds looking down on him. The
spear drops and clatters onto the stones, his arms fall slack, he stands upright and motionless
for one beat, then one knee folds and his whole weight pitches forward until the scale back-plate
lands flat against the riverbed floor and dust bursts outward across the cobbles. The
shield-bearer drops the tall shield and runs. On the far slope the front shields drop away and the
forest of spears tilts backward as the locked ranks give ground; on the near side the thin line
breaks forward with arms going up and runs down onto the riverbed.
END STATE: the giant lies face down on the riverbed with the two crowds streaming in opposite
directions past him.

LIGHT: hard midday sun from high right; short dense shadows; heat haze rising off the stones.

SOUND: rushing air, close and constant; the low mass of an army below; the rising whir of the
swinging sling, faster on each rotation, ending in a hard snap; the air drops to near silence
through the slowed beat; a spear clattering on stone; the heavy collapse of armor onto gravel;
then a rising roar from one side and falling voices from the other.

STYLE: shot on 35mm anamorphic, 2-perf, grounded photographic realism.
Anamorphic character throughout: subtle horizontal lens flare on the sun,
oval bokeh in the out-of-focus gravel, slight edge stretching at the frame
extremes, gentle barrel distortion on fast camera moves. Visible film grain,
halation blooming softly around the brightest highlights. Muted earth palette
of bone, ochre and olive; hard midday contrast with detail retained in the
shadows.

AVOID: no cuts, no camera teleporting or jumping, no hovering or drifting, no sliding or floating

你是一位专注于 AI 和创意技术内容的专业翻译。

请将以下文本翻译成简体中文。

规则：
1. 准确保留所有技术术语（例如，“prompt”、“cinematic”、“camera pan” 可以保留英文，或使用目标语言中通行的译法）。
2. 译文要自然流畅，不要逐字直译。
3. 保留所有格式（换行、项目符号等）。
4. 如果文本中包含实际的 Seedance/AI prompt（生成指令），请保持英文不翻译，只翻译周围的上下文/说明。

待翻译文本：
---
一镜到底的空中 FPV 镜头，全程使用同一虚拟镜头，无剪切。

镜头以高速沿一条连续不断的路径飞行：先低空跟在前进的装甲巨人身后，向前掠过他到达孤身少年，绕少年一圈，然后沿着石块飞行的轨迹飞向巨人头盔后方，最后在他倒下时从上方掠过。所有尺度变化都只来自镜头和主体的运动。镜头始终不停移动，也绝不悬停；地平线保持稳定，转弯时自然倾斜，只在抵达某个主体时才减速。

主角：一名瘦削少年，身穿粗糙的未染色羊毛束腰衣，手臂裸露，小腿上沾着尘土。右手垂着一条皮制投石索：一端绳索末端是一个已经套在中指上的环，另一端末端打着结。左手里握着一块光滑的浅色石头。

对立主体：一名巨大的装甲人物，全程都从背后可见——青铜鳞甲背板、高耸的羽饰头盔、肩膀宽度是常人的两倍，右手持一柄长矛。他正向前行进。前方有一名仅及其一半身高的持盾者，举着一面高盾走在前面。

远处军阵，位于巨人身后：深密锁定的青铜方阵，竖直高大的矩形盾牌边缘相互重叠，每顶头盔都带着同样的羽饰，密集挺立的长矛如森林般林立，深色旗帜在风中僵硬地竖着。军阵保持队形，不会移动。

近处队列，位于少年身后：只有一条单薄的队列，由穿皮革和未染色布料的士兵组成，装备参差不齐，彼此间隔很大，长矛很少，也没有旗帜。有人在调整重心；无人向前迈步。

场景：正午时分，一条干涸的河床切过宽阔山谷；远岸附近是开裂的浅色泥地，中段是松散的灰色碎石，近端是被水磨圆的卵石；两侧是石灰岩坡地向上延伸。

[0:00-0:03] 镜头从巨人背后低空高速猛冲而入，剧烈倾斜，并在不减速的情况下只抬升到足以越过他羽饰的高度。他的肩膀随着每一步起伏，长矛在身侧摆动，持盾者则拼命加快脚步想要保持在他前方。越过他之后，锁定的青铜军阵占据远坡，盾牌层层相叠，旗帜在风中僵直。
结束状态：羽饰头盔和鳞甲背板充满画面，后方是密集的军队。

[0:03-0:06] 镜头以全速掠过巨人，沿着河床纵向冲出，然后猛然减速，停在少年的视线高度。少年正踩着卵石朝巨人走去，左手握着石头，右手垂着投石索；当镜头抵达时，他停了下来。远处的那条单薄队列静静站着观望。
结束状态：少年独自站立，面向前方，巨人的装甲背影在他肩后高高耸起。

[0:06-0:13] 镜头放慢到步行速度，围绕少年平稳转一圈，始终让他居于画面中央，而山谷在他身后旋转。少年把投石索的囊袋抬到左手中，将石头放进去，合拢囊袋包住石头，然后用拇指和食指捏住打结的那根绳端。装好石头的囊袋向下摆去，两根绳索都被拉直。越过他的肩膀，装甲背影和持盾者越来越大。
结束状态：装好石头的囊袋停在摆动最低点，两根绳索绷紧。

[0:13-0:17] 镜头在他肩侧完成这一圈，然后脱离并加速掠过他，随着投石索每一次旋转不断提速。他稳住肩膀，在头侧挥动投石索，连续做出三次平展的旋转，每一次都比上一次更快、更大，扬起脚下碎石上的尘粒。他的前脚重重踏稳，髋部顺势转动，拇指和食指张开；打结的绳端脱手飞出，两根绳索猛然绷直，他的手臂随之完成跨身的跟随动作，束腰衣在肋侧猛地抽动。
结束状态：石头已脱离他的手，正在飞行中。

[0:17-0:22] 镜头以高速贴着石头并行，跟随它冲向羽饰头盔。石头始终位于画面下方中央，近景且细节清晰，缓慢旋转；下方的碎石和山谷地面在强烈运动模糊中飞速掠过；地面几乎慢到静止，尘粒悬在空中，随后又比之前更快地掠过。头盔充满画面。
结束状态：石头击中头盔后部，羽饰猛然向上翻起。

[0:22-0:30] 镜头在巨人倒下时向上越过他，并保持俯视。长矛落下，撞击石面发出哐啷声，他的双臂松垮下垂，他先是笔直僵立了一拍，然后一条膝盖弯折，整个人的重量向前倾倒，直到鳞甲背板平平地砸在河床上，尘土向四周卵石间爆开。持盾者丢下高盾逃跑。远坡上，前排盾牌纷纷落下，长矛林向后倾斜，锁定的军阵开始后退；近侧那条单薄队列则举起手臂向前冲出，奔下河床。
结束状态：巨人面朝下倒在河床上，两群人从他两侧朝相反方向奔流而过。

光线：高处右侧射来的强烈正午阳光；短而浓密的阴影；石头上方升腾着热浪。

声音：持续不断、近距离的呼啸风声；下方军队低沉的整体声势；投石索挥动时逐渐升高的嗡鸣，每转一圈都更快，最后以一记干脆的抽响收束；在减速的那一拍里，空气几乎静止；长矛撞击石面的声音；盔甲重重砸在碎石上的闷响；随后一侧响起逐渐高涨的怒吼，另一侧则是不断低落的呼声。

风格：采用 35mm anamorphic、2-perf 拍摄，扎实的摄影现实主义。
全程保持 anamorphic 特征：太阳处有细微的水平镜头光晕，失焦碎石呈椭圆形散景，画面边缘在极端位置略有拉伸，快速运镜时有轻微桶形畸变。可见胶片颗粒，最亮高光周围有柔和的光晕扩散。低饱和的大地色调，以骨白、赭石和橄榄色为主；强烈的正午反差，但阴影中仍保留细节。

避免：不要剪切，不要镜头传送
